description: Block NIFTY VP-15 SELL signals when EMA stack is neutral (neither bullish nor bearish alignment).
evidence: On 2026-06-04, NIFTY VP-15 SELL setups that fired during neutral EMA stacking (ema_stacked_bull=false AND ema_stacked_bear=false) showed no clear trend confirmation. The Gemini gatekeeper was uncertain on several of these and mentioned the lack of EMA directional confirmation in its reasoning. A deterministic block when the EMA stack is neutral may reduce noise trades for this strategy.
